title: SIRT1 activation by Taurine: in vitro evaluation, molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation studies.
authors: Kp, Arya Devi; Shimoga Janakirama, Aditya Rao; Martin, Asha
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨牛磺酸激活SIRT1蛋白的机制，涉及分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题TF-DNA结合研究无关。
abstract: Sirtuin1 (SIRT1) plays a major role in regulating different genes involved in several metabolic pathways. SIRT1 activators have protective role in several metabolic disorders. Taurine, a sulfur containing amino acid is involved in many physiological functions and has been reported as a beneficial molecule for regulating metabolic disorders. This study aims to investigate the effect of taurine on SIRT1 activation and its underlying mechanism. HepG2 cells were treated with different concentrations of Taurine. Subsequently, the cellular mRNA and protein expression and enzyme activity of SIRT1 were analyzed using quantitative real time and reverse transcriptase PCR, western blot and fluorescent assays. The effect of Taurine on key genes involved in lipid metabolism viz. PPAR-alpha, LXR-beta, SREBP-1c and PGC-1alpha were analyzed using mRNA and protein expression data. The results showed a significant increase in SIRT1 protein expression and its activity levels (P<.05) in the cells treated with Taurine. PPAR-alpha, LXR-beta, PGC-1alpha mRNA and protein levels were increased and SREBP-1c expression was decreased after treatment. Molecular docking and molecular dynamic simulation studies were carried out to understand the binding of taurine to SIRT1 protein with resveratrol as reference molecule. Molecular docking and simulation studies endorse the role of taurine in SIRT1 activation.  In conclusion, our data collectively establishes Taurine as a positive regulator of SIRT1.  The lipid lowering effect of Taurine via modulation of lipid metabolic genes may contribute to protection against metabolic disorders like obesity and age-related disease in humans.
abstract_zh: Sirtuin1（SIRT1）在调控参与多种代谢途径的不同基因中发挥重要作用。SIRT1激活剂在多种代谢性疾病中具有保护作用。牛磺酸是一种含硫氨基酸，参与多种生理功能，并已被报道为调节代谢性疾病的有益分子。本研究旨在探讨牛磺酸对SIRT1激活的影响及其潜在机制。用不同浓度的牛磺酸处理HepG2细胞。随后，使用定量实时PCR、逆转录PCR、蛋白质印迹和荧光分析检测细胞中SIRT1的mRNA和蛋白质表达及酶活性。通过mRNA和蛋白质表达数据分析牛磺酸对脂质代谢关键基因（即PPAR-alpha、LXR-beta、SREBP-1c和PGC-1alpha）的影响。结果显示，牛磺酸处理细胞中SIRT1蛋白表达及其活性水平显著增加（P<.05）。处理后，PPAR-alpha、LXR-beta、PGC-1alpha的mRNA和蛋白质水平升高，而SREBP-1c表达降低。进行分子对接和分子动力学模拟研究，以白藜芦醇为参考分子，了解牛磺酸与SIRT1蛋白的结合情况。分子对接和模拟研究证实了牛磺酸在SIRT1激活中的作用。总之，我们的数据共同确立了牛磺酸作为SIRT1的正向调节因子。牛磺酸通过调节脂质代谢基因产生的降脂作用可能有助于预防人类肥胖和年龄相关疾病等代谢性疾病。
